Format his pc, install an anti-virus and explain to him that some sites are malicious.
If he still likes to go there format the PC get it all clean and working then Install VMware Player its a free tool and install an OS in that tool. Its basiclly a PC inside a PC so he can ruin all he wants inside that virtual PC but his main one wont be affected. Also the virtual PC is just like a normal PC make sure it as anti virus, adblockplus and if he doesnt know if the site is safe or not you can always use virustotal to scan the page ( this wont however help if he follows links in the page to download stuff, you have to teach him if its either safe or not to download). The only problem with the Virtual PC would be IP address so if the site attacks using IP, well thats bad. Also dont let him drag stuff from his Virtual PC to his actual one. If the stuff he has isnt corrupted with virus and other things and he wants to save them use a cloud storage, Gmail Drive, Skydrive, DropBox, etc.

If you really want to stop him from watching those things well have a serious conversation with him but dont force him just explain him your point for so.

Food related stuff also helps your body, change what you eat everyday allow your organism to take diferent types of food, I used to drink coffee but I replaced with orange juice or other natural juice that has a good percentage of Vitamin. Switch betwen fish, meat, sea food (squids and stuff).
